Question: Amy, Bomani, Charlie, and Daria work in a chocolate factory. On Monday Amy, Bomani, and Charlie started working at \(1{:}00\) PM and were able to pack \(4,\) \(3,\) and \(3\) packages, respectively, every \(3\) minutes. At some later time, Daria joined the group, and Daria was able to pack \(5\) packages every \(4\) minutes. Together, they finished packing \(450\) packages at exactly \(2{:}45\) PM. At what time did Daria join the group?
